member.name: T:GitHubCrawler.GitHubCrawlerTelemetry
member.summary: Public, stable names for every telemetry point GitHubCrawler emits. The library emits only through the base class library ( and ) and takes no exporter or SDK dependency. Emission is effectively free until a host subscribes to and . These names are a public contract consumed by dashboards and alerts. Do not rename them casually. See TELEMETRY.md in the repository root for the full catalog. This class is thread-safe (it contains only constants).

member.summary: Asynchronously retrieves all file URLs from a GitHub repository. Emits the "githubcrawler crawl_repository" span with one "github contents.list" child per directory, and the githubcrawler.operation.* and githubcrawler.github.* metrics. See TELEMETRY.md.

member.name: M:GitHubCrawler.GitHubRepoCrawler.GetFileContentsAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Asynchronously downloads file contents from a GitHub URL. Emits the "githubcrawler get_file_contents" span with a "github file.download" child, and the githubcrawler.operation.*, githubcrawler.github.*, and githubcrawler.file.download.size metrics. A response with a status code of 400 or above is returned to the caller as before, and is recorded as a failure with error.type set to the status code.
member.param: A cancellation token that can be used to cancel the operation.
member.returns: A GitHubFileResponse containing the file content and metadata.
member.exception: Thrown when this method is called after the object has been disposed.
Thrown when the URL is null or empty.
Thrown when the file cannot be fetched.
Thrown when the operation is cancelled.
